deadline.value: January 31 application deadline for full consideration.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for International (all visa types) is January 31.

gre_subject.value: GRE Chemistry test is optional but encouraged for fellowship consideration.
gre_subject.quote: Request Educational Testing Service (ETS) to send GRE Chemistry or Physics Test scores to the University of Houston Main Campus (ETS code 6870). These tests are optional but encouraged for consideration of fellowship awards.

supervisor.value: Admitted students have until end of January of their second semester to choose a research advisor.
supervisor.quote: If you are admitted, you have until the beginning of your second semester (end of January) to choose a research advisor.

funding.value: All Ph.D. students admitted are automatically given a Teaching Assistantship for the first year.

entry_route.value: Requires undergraduate degree conferral prior to enrollment.
entry_route.quote: Please follow these instructions to properly scan and upload your transcript. If admitted, however, you will not be able to enroll without the official transcript(s) showing undergraduate degree conferral on file.
